about: Keys Atlas trusts to sign image files: a minisign signature <file>.minisig next to the file. Each key carries who owns it. Add a key here (or in your own trusted-keys.json, see src/trust.rs); no code change is needed.

keys.name: Prometheus Dynamics dev/example key
keys.note: Signs dev builds of HeliOS and PhotonVision. Not for production: its private key is unencrypted on developer machines.
